Home.exploreDescription: Shindeka malipoti kwa mahali, mahoja, ndimi na mwaawino koro umenye shikwitendeka pa nsi.
Home.faq1Answer: Watchtower ni kinu cha kukupa malipoti cha milulimi mingi na cha kududula uwebhala wa sengo, chikuganja bandu kukupa malipoti ga mihayo ya sengo na kusuka mahamba mululimi lwabho gwakupa. Malipoti gaga no gaganywa, gajandwa mulukoma na gagaanwa kugema mihayo yoneke na kugema unanzo.
Home.faq2Answer: Upalila malipoti ga mihayo kamba kusuka mahamba, ubhaya wa nzengo na mihayo miji ya sengo li ikoleyo: inyabho abhandu bhena bhidatalile kumanya oba yiganyaga kugema unanzo.
Home.faq2Question: Nabyaki bonhu nakupa ilipoti pa Watchtower?
Home.faq3Answer: Ee. Ilipoti ukombwa no lwemio oba jandiko mululimi ugwili gwilolele, na Watchtower yahandika, yagaana na kuganya ilipoti lyako kugema lithulile mululimi gwose.
Home.faq4Answer: Ee. Ukudumbulwa kuli mwiguti, sio mbigano: utagema linina lyago oba uwebhala ng'wigine uduge kukupa ilipoti.
Home.faq5Answer: Ilipoti josia jigaluwa na jiduduliwa, jakolelwa mulukoma jili na jigasho kugema mihayo yoneke, na jinuwa na sengo, makomando na mala agapanda kugema unanzo.
Home.faqsDescription: Bona uwebhala umo bididhile malipoti, milulimi, siri na nhala Watchtower yidita uwebhala wa sengo gubhoneke gwakutumika.
Home.heroDescription: Watchtower ikuganja bandu kupa malipoti ga mahoja ga sengo na kusuka mahamba gadagu mululimi lwabwe, koro buli mundu ashobole kwingila mu wikaji wa witemi na kubazwa kwa bose.
Home.howItWorksDescription: Kuhuma ilipoti imo hadi kulabuka kwa nkola yoshi, uu niyo Watchtower ikuganja makundi kwiguwa na kuleta kulabuka kwina mana.
Home.insightsDescription: Tovera ulupalo lwa kukupa malipoti ga sengo, ubhiki wa nzengo, teknoloji ya milulimi mingi na nhala ng'waho uwebhala ubhuhija kugema ng'waJuma unanzo ugubhona.
Home.insightsFallback1Title: Nhundagwa sauti za makaya gakoleya kududula ejo jiilwe panhi lwa isi
Home.insightsFallback2Title: Kudumaga ngolo ya lulimi mu kukupa malipoti ga sengo
Home.insightsFallback3Title: Kukuma mu malipoti ga mundu umo kuya ku mihayo ya maana
Home.insightsHeading: Miganilo, masala na ubino wa mihayo.
Home.speakNaturallyDescription: Watchtower yandika, yagaana na kuganya ilipoti, kugema uwebhala gubhoneke gwilomwilwe, ilipoti lyagakolagwa mululimi gweng'we.
Home.step1Description: Tukupa tekinolojia yikuganja bandu na makundi kupa malipoti ga mahoja ga sengo naho mahamba gadagu, kuhuma ku simu naho kompyuta yabo mululimi lwabwe.
Home.step2Description: Tukola na kuhakikisha ilipoti yoshi, tukushindeka mahoja pa malambo na kubona mienendo yashaga kumanyika. Habali ya kwanza ikulabuka bumanyi bulangililwe na busimbu bukuloga habali inene.
Home.step3Description: Makundi, mashirika na inzu ja witemi bakwingila mu bumanyi ubu kuzenga mashitaka, kubaza bakola makosa, na kutoma kulabuka kwina mana, kwina bushaidi bwa kweli kuhuma pa nsi.
Home.impactDescription: Menya iti makundi bakwiguwa buli, bakushindeka maamuzi na bakuleta shikomo.
About.ctaDescription: Tuma ilipoti ya ihoja lya witemi mululimi lwako. Kutali akaundi yihitajika, kutali habali yako mwenyewe yihitajika.
About.faqAccountAnswer: Kutali profaili ya kuzenga naho kwingila kufuatililwa. Wiza, upa ilipoti, wigende. Kutali shindu shikukubatanya na showatuma.
About.faqDeviceAnswer: Ee. WatchTower ishagabikila habali ya sesheni naho cookies jikubatana na showatuma. Kupa ilipoti kuhuma pa shombo shashirikiwe ishagulete hatari.
About.faqDeviceQuestion: Je, nishobola kupa ilipoti kuhuma pa shombo shashirikiwe naho sha bose?
About.faqEncryptionAnswer: Shindu shoshi showatuma shikubikilwa kuhuma katika lisaa lyowatuma. Ilipoti yako ishobola kunashwa naho kumanyika kubuya kuli uwe pakati pa kutumwa.
About.faqEncryptionQuestion: Je, showatuma shishobola kumanyika kubuya kuli nenga?
About.faqIdentityAnswer: Utahitajika kupa jina lyako, namba ya simu, naho habali yoshi yikumanyisha koro kupa ilipoti. Kutamanyika niyo kawaida, sio itofauti.
About.faqIdentityQuestion: Je, mwenendo gwane gukubikilwa nikupa ilipoti?
About.faqVisibilityAnswer: Malipoti gakalangililwa na batumishi ba WatchTower bahakikishwe duhu. Showatuma ishagusukwa hadharani na habali yoyose yikumanyisha.
About.heroDescription: WatchTower ni jukwaa lya bwenge bwa witemi lyalangililwe na makundi likukola AI na tekinolojia ya ndimi ja shilambo kuganja bandu kupa malipoti ga mahoja, hatari na mahamba gadagu mululimi lwabwe, na likulabula malipoti aga habali ikushobola kukolwa kwa kubazwa na kwitika.
About.languagesDescription: Watchtower nono ikuganja ndimi {count} kukola maluli menji ga makundi gashobole kwingila, kwiguwa na kusaidia kubazwa kwa bose mululimi lulo bali balangaga kutoma.
About.objectiveDescription: Kuhakikisha buli mundu ali na uwezo wa kupa malipoti ga mahoja ga witemi mululimi lwake, koro luli lyoshi lutasaga kwiguwa na buli mundu ashobole kwingila mu kubaza bakola makosa.
About.safetyDescription: Tukumanya iti kulonga kukwiza kuleta hatari. Uu niyo Watchtower ikuzengelwe kukubikila.
Security.metaDescription: Iti wapa ilipoti ya ubinafsi ku udhaifu wa usalama kwa timu ya AmplifiedAccess.
Security.heroDescription: Iti tukushika malipoti ga udhaifu na ahadi yitu ku kusukwa kwa ubinafsi.
Security.intro: AmplifiedAccess ikubala usalama wa WatchTower kwa nguvu. Tukushukuru bidii ja bakolaji ba usalama na bandu ba makundi bakutusaidia kubikila jukwaa lina usalama kwa bandu bose.
Security.reportingWarning: Tafadhali usipe malipoti ga udhaifu wa usalama kupitila ku mahoja ga GitHub ga hadharani.
Security.reportingInstruction: Badala yakwe, gapele moja kwa moja kwa timu yitu kwa email:
Security.reportingResponseTime: Ulitegemewa kupata jibu mukati mwa masaa 48. Kama utapata, tafadhali fuatilila kwa email kuhakikisha tulipata ujumbe wako wa kwanza.
Security.whatToIncludeIntro: Koro utusaidile kuchunguza ilipoti yako haraka, tafadhali batanya vitu avi kadiri ushobolele:
Security.includeItem1: Aina ya tatizo (nge SQL injection, cross-site scripting, authentication bypass, privilege escalation, na jingi)
Security.includeItem2: Njila jinene ja faili ja mwanzo jikubatana na tatizo
Security.includeItem3: Pandu code yikosekile ili (tawi, commit hash, naho URL moja kwa moja)
Security.includeItem4: Utaratibu wowose wa pekee ukuhitajika kurudia tatizo
Security.includeItem5: Maelekezo litengo hadi litengo kurudia tatizo
Security.includeItem6: Ushaidi wa wazo naho code ya exploit, kama ishobokana
Security.includeItem7: Athari ja tatizo, kubatanya iti mumashambulizi ashobole kulikola buli
Security.disclosurePolicy: AmplifiedAccess ikufuata kanuni ya <link>Kusukwa kwa Udhaifu Kulangililwe</link>. Tukuomba mutupe muda ukwiganila kuchunguza na kutatua tatizo lyapewe ilipoti kabla ya kusukwa kwoshoshe kwa hadharani.
Security.disclosureFollowUp: Tulikwazisha maendeleo gitu pakati pa uchunguzi na tulikupa sifa ku ugunduzi wako kama ulitogwa.
Security.languageText: Tukutogwa mawasiliano goshi ga usalama gabe mu Kiingereza.
CodeOfConduct.metaDescription: Kiwango sha makundi sha AmplifiedAccess na kanuni ja mwenendo kwa bachangiaji na bashiriki.
CodeOfConduct.heroDescription: Ahadi yitu kwa makundi gikwiguliwa, gikwakalibisha, na gatali gina unyanyasaji kwa bose.
CodeOfConduct.pledgeText1: Aswi kama bashiriki, bachangiaji, na baongozi ba makundi ga AmplifiedAccess tukwahidi kukola kwingila mu makundi getu kubatilo bwa unyanyasaji kwa bose, bila kulola umri, ukubwa wa mwili, ulemavu ulonekana naho utalonekana, kabila, sifa ja jinsia, utambulisho na maonyesho ga jinsia, kiwango sha ujuzi, elimu, hali ya kijamii na kiuchumi, uraia, muonekano wa mwenyewe, kabila, tabaka, rangi, dini, naho utambulisho na mwelekeo wa kijinsia.
CodeOfConduct.pledgeText2: Tukwahidi kukola na kushiriki kwa njila jikuongeza mu makundi gikwiguliwa, gikwakalibisha, gitofauti, gakubatanya bose, na gina afya.
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositiveIntro: Mifano ya mwenendo ukwongeza mazingira mazuri gabatanya:
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive1: Kubonesha huruma na wema kwa bandu bangi
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive2: Kuheshimu maoni, mitazamo, na ujuzi utofauti
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive3: Kupa na kwitikila kwa unyenyekevu maoni gakwongeza
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive4: Kubala jukumu na kuomba radhi kwa balo bakosekile na makosa gitu, na kwiguwa kuhuma mu ujuzi
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive5: Kuangalila shikwongeza sio kwa aswi kama bandu duhu, ila kwa makundi goshi
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative1: Kukola lulimi naho picha ja kijinsia, na dalili naho jaribio lyoshose lya kijinsia
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative2: Kuchokoza, maoni ga kudharau naho kuchambua, na mashambulizi ga mwenyewe naho ga kisiasa
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative3: Unyanyasaji wa hadharani naho wa mwenyewe
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative4: Kusuka habali ya mwenyewe ja bangi, nge anwani ya nyumba naho ya email, bila ruhusa yikulangililwa
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative5: Mwenendo gungi gwoshose gwikubalika kubalilwa gatakubalika mu shombo sha kazi
CodeOfConduct.enforcementResponsibilitie: Baongozi ba makundi mu AmplifiedAccess bali na jukumu lya kulangilila na kutekeleza kiwango situ sha mwenendo ukubalika na balikola shikomo shikubatana na shina haki kwa mwenendo woshose ubalibonaga gutakubalika, gikutisha, gikudharau, naho gikuletela madhara.

Baongozi ba makundi bali na haki na jukumu lya kuondosha, kubadilisha, naho kukatala maoni, commits, code, mabadiliko ga wiki, mahoja, na michango yingi yishagukubatana na Kanuni aji ja Mwenendo, na balikwazisha sababu ja maamuzi ga usimamizi lifu likubatana.
CodeOfConduct.scopeText: Kanuni aji ja Mwenendo jikutumika mukati mwa mahali goshi ga makundi, na jikutumika pia mundu nakuwakilisha rasmi makundi ga AmplifiedAccess mu mahali ga hadharani. Mifano ya kuwakilisha makundi getu gabatanya kukola anwani ya email rasmi, kuandika kupitila akaunti ya mitandao ya kijamii rasmi, naho kukola nge mwakilishi ateuliwe mu tukio lya mtandaoni naho litali lya mtandaoni.
CodeOfConduct.reportingIntro: Matukio ga mwenendo mubaya, unyanyasaji, naho gungi gutakubalika gashobole kupewa ilipoti kwa timu ya AmplifiedAccess kwa:
CodeOfConduct.reportingFollowUp: Malalamiko goshi galilangililwa na kuchunguzwa haraka na kwa haki. Baongozi bose ba makundi bali na jukumu lya kuheshimu ubwiswii na usalama wa mundu upa ilipoti ya tukio lyoshose.
CodeOfConduct.guidelinesIntro: Baongozi ba makundi balifuata miongozo ali mu kuamua matokeo ga shikomo shoshose babalibonaga shikuvunja Kanuni aji ja Mwenendo:
CodeOfConduct.correctionImpactText: Kukola lulimi lutakubalika naho mwenendo gungi gubaliwe gatali gwa kitaalamu naho gatakutogwa mu makundi.
CodeOfConduct.correctionConsequenceText: Onyo lya mwenyewe lyandikilwe kuhuma kwa baongozi ba makundi, likupa uwazi ku aina ya ukiukaji na maelezo ga sababu mwenendo gutakubalika. Radhi ya hadharani ishobole kuombwa.
CodeOfConduct.warningImpactText: Ukiukaji kupitila tukio limo naho mfululizo gwa vitendo.
CodeOfConduct.warningConsequenceText: Onyo lina matokeo kwa mwenendo gwiendelela. Kutali mashirikiano na bandu babatanikile, kubatanya mashirikiano gatakuombwe na balo bakutekeleza Kanuni ja Mwenendo, kwa muda utaarifiwe. Kuvunja masharti aga kishobole kuleta kuzuiwa kwa muda naho ga kudumu.
CodeOfConduct.temporaryBanImpactText: Ukiukaji mkubwa gwa kiwango sha makundi, kubatanya mwenendo utakubalika gwiendelela.
CodeOfConduct.temporaryBanConsequenceTex: Kuzuiwa kwa muda gwa aina yoyose ya mashirikiano naho mawasiliano ga hadharani na makundi kwa muda utaarifiwe. Kutali mashirikiano ga hadharani naho ga mwenyewe na balo babatanikile gakubaliwa pakati pa muda ugu. Kuvunja masharti aga kishobole kuleta kuzuiwa kwa kudumu.
CodeOfConduct.permanentBanImpactText: Kubonesha mfumo gwa ukiukaji gwa kiwango sha makundi, kubatanya mwenendo utakubalika gwiendelela, unyanyasaji gwa mundu, naho ushambulizi kwa naho kudharau makundi ga bandu.
CodeOfConduct.permanentBanConsequenceTex: Kuzuiwa kwa kudumu gwa aina yoyose ya mashirikiano ga hadharani mukati mwa makundi.
